sources.entry: Robo 3T - Robo 3T (formerly Robomongo) is the free lightweight GUI for MongoDB enthusiasts.

summary.one_liner: Robo 3T (formerly Robomongo) is a cross-platform desktop GUI for MongoDB that embeds the mongo shell in a tabbed interface; it is no longer actively developed by Studio 3T.
summary.what_it_does: Robo 3T is a shell-centric MongoDB management tool that runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It embeds the actual mongo shell in a tabbed interface, so users can type shell commands alongside GUI interaction. The README says the latest release, 1.4, embeds the MongoDB 4.2 shell, and it lists earlier versions with their embedded shells (1.3 to MongoDB 4.0, down to 0.8.x to 2.4.0). Version 1.4 adds SSH ECDSA and Ed25519 key support on Windows and macOS, the ability to manually specify visible databases, and a Welcome tab built on QtWebEngine. The README also mentions SSH and authentication database handling and index add/edit fixes. The README describes the project as no longer developed by Studio 3T, with 1.4.4 as the last release and the repository left online as a record.
use_cases: Browse and query MongoDB databases from a desktop app
Run mongo shell commands in a GUI with tabs
Manage MongoDB indexes and admin users
Connect to MongoDB over SSH tunnels
Inspect collections and documents on Windows, macOS, or Linux
how_to_run: Download the installer for your platform from the Robo 3T release links or from www.robomongo.org
Create a connection to your MongoDB server
Open a shell tab to run mongo shell commands
notable: Embeds the actual mongo shell in tabbed windows rather than replacing it with a custom query UI
Shell version mapping: each release lists which MongoDB shell version it embeds
Supports SSH connections with ECDSA and Ed25519 keys on Windows and macOS
caveats: No longer developed by Studio 3T; last release is 1.4.4, and Studio 3T does not monitor this repo for its issues
Studio 3T recommends Studio 3T Free as the successor GUI
Supported platforms depend on MongoDB versions; the README lists Windows 7 and 8.1, macOS 10.14 and later, and Ubuntu 18.04 and 20.04 as supported
